source_quote: Initial Staging, Restaging, Pre-surgical evaluation, Recurrence, Surveillance ○ NOT Indicated

criteria.description: Patient has confirmed diagnosis of primary chondrosarcoma

required_documentation: Pathology or oncology notes documenting conventional chondrosarcoma
exclusion_conditions: PET/CT is non-covered for staging, restaging, pre-surgical planning, recurrence, or surveillance of standard chondrosarcoma
review_notes: Explicit non-coverage policy exclusion: chondrosarcoma is evaluated with conventional CT/MRI rather than PET.

source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Indicated to clarify inconclusive conventional imaging

criteria.description: Biopsy-proven chordoma undergoing staging or restaging
Conventional CT or MRI studies of the primary site, chest, or abdomen/pelvis are inconclusive or equivocal

required_documentation: Conventional CT/MRI reports documenting indeterminate findings requiring metabolic PET clarification
review_notes: Diagnostic clarification pathway for chordoma when conventional imaging is inconclusive.

criteria.description: Suspected or confirmed allergic fungal rhinosinusitis or invasive fungal sinusitis

required_documentation: ENT examination notes, nasal endoscopy findings, or allergy/immunology testing demonstrating fungal sinusitis features
review_notes: Complex complicated sinusitis indication evaluating bony sinus erosion and expansion.

source_quote: Suspected optic neuritis with any ONE of the following (8):

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of acute optic neuritis (afferent pupillary defect, visual field loss, pain with eye movement)

required_documentation: Ophthalmology or neurology consultation notes detailing visual acuity, color desaturation, RAPD, or papillitis
review_notes: Urgent optic neuritis evaluation for demyelinating disease (MS/MOG/NMO).

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR SPINAL CANAL MR ANGIOGRAPHY (MRA)

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion or evaluation of spinal vascular malformation (spinal AVM or spinal dural arteriovenous fistula)

required_documentation: Spine MRI report demonstrating prominent flow voids or cord edema (Foix-Alajouanine syndrome) and neurosurgical consultation
review_notes: Non-invasive vascular evaluation of spinal vascular malformations.

source_quote: For further evaluation of known sellar and/or parasellar masses

criteria.description: Known sellar, suprasellar, or parasellar mass requiring bony evaluation of sella turcica or surgical planning

required_documentation: Endocrine or neurosurgical consultation notes and prior brain MRI report showing pituitary/sellar lesion
review_notes: Sellar architecture evaluation for pituitary surgical approaches.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR TEMPOROMANDIBULAR JOINT (TMJ) MRI / Suspected Internal TMJ Derangement

criteria.description: Suspected internal derangement of the temporomandibular joint with mechanical locking, persistent pain, or limitation of mouth opening

required_documentation: Dental or oral maxillofacial surgical examination documenting persistent TMJ dysfunction, clicking/locking, and conservative splint/PT failure
review_notes: TMJ articular disc displacement and derangement evaluation.
